revision.requirement: both raw rounds match receipt expected_revision

all_days.requirement: one settlement at every day sample

overflow.requirement: owned same-tick overflow max <= 2 from first formation

coverage.requirement: 59 snapshots per seed at each of 02:00,12:00,19:30

night_in_shelter_share.requirement: median over days per seed, then across seeds >= 0.7

evening_near_hearth_share.requirement: median over days per seed, then across seeds >= 0.5

implemented.requirement: children implemented; dropped scope is FAIL

child_share.requirement: median per-seed children/alive at day10 in (0,.45]

maturation.requirement: successful every-tick bound checks and nonzero observed maturation

actionable_10.requirement: median cumulative periodic actionable breach share <= .01

actionable_60.requirement: median cumulative periodic actionable breach share <= .01

notes: U7 compares marginal stock/need medians; paired margins also reported.
U10 and U11 apply thresholds to both run durations.
Timing excludes measured in-tick census work and all post-tick observation, I/O and twin validation.
Raw clock day differs from elapsed checkpoint day. Missing clock evidence fails U8.
Maturation covers observed living children; children still alive at run end are right-censored.
